scoring.pairing: maximum-cardinality onset-only then minimum total absolute onset error; pitch never selects pairs

primaryGate.performerFloor: for every one of the 27 frozen performers, intervention F1 >= comparator F1 - 0.10
primaryGate.contentFamilyFloor: for declared family 'classical solo guitar', intervention macro F1 >= comparator macro F1 + 0.10 AND >= 0.60

rationale: Require a material 10-point absolute F1 and precision gain, retain useful recall, prevent event-count flooding/underproduction, and forbid a gain purchased by severe performer-specific regressions.
